integrity: An elementary proof is included, accompanied by reproducible finite literal-enumeration tests. Finite checks do not replace the proof and no independent audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Only cyclic periods with at least three pairwise distinct letter-runs and positive lengths; distinct contiguous Abelian-square factor strings, not occurrence multiplicities or Abelian-equivalence classes. No classification for binary two-run periods or repeated letters among run labels. Literature coverage remains incomplete.
title: Exact Abelian-square spectra of periodic distinct-run words
